new_result.statement: For disjoint original-coordinate product banks X,Y,Z with cap-one scalar densities, T=X^T M Y+a(beta^T Z+H(Y))^2+c has a continuous C0 density and ||p_T||_inf <= K_beta/sqrt(|a|) * min{K_HP/sqrt(||M||_HS), 8/sqrt(||M||_op)}, where K_beta<=sqrt(2)/||beta||_2.
new_result.scope_limits: The Hilbert-Schmidt branch does not include an arbitrary additive G(Y) or alpha^T X. Continuity and the operator-norm branch are inherited from account03/B18 auto20 on the same narrower form.

proof_mechanism: Condition on original X,Y only to expose the independent private bank Z.
The density of a(beta^T Z+H(Y))^2 has the translation-uniform envelope K_beta/(sqrt(|a|)|s|^(1/2)); its critical output value is zero for every Y.
Average this envelope to reduce to sup_t E|X^T M Y-t|^(-1/2).
Apply account03/B18 auto19 Hu-Paouris/Juskevicius-Lee Hilbert-Schmidt half-Riesz bound.
Apply latest account03/B18 auto20 separately for the operator-norm branch and C0 continuity.
primary_sources_checked: Rudelson-Vershynin arXiv:1402.4492 Theorem 1.2: independent real variables, density cap K, l2-normalized coefficients, density bound sqrt(2)K.
Juskevicius-Lee arXiv:1503.09190 Theorem 1: concentration rearrangement for sums of independent bounded-density random vectors.
Hu-Paouris arXiv:2403.20192 Theorems 1.1 and 1.3: tensor small balls and stochastic dominance for independent component vectors with independent bounded-density coordinates.
